manual: Build with community-apps/omaview/install.sh. Prefers CMake; falls back to omaview.pro + qmake6.
Needs ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH for probes, scrub previews, and frame extract.
Optional: cups (lp for print), wireplumber (wpctl for volume above 100%).
Hyprland corner rounding / reshape are skipped when HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset.
Idle inhibit uses org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver or xdg-screensaver (not Wayland idle-inhibit).
If apt cannot match libqt6core for qml6-module-qtmultimedia, place QtMultimedia under ~/.local/lib/qt6/qml/ — install.sh wraps the binary like Omacut.
